description: Add a message to an existing support ticket of the account, optionally with images (screenshots): PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF in base64, at most 5 per message; the whole MCP request is limited to 1 MB (so about 700 KB of images). The text may be empty when an image is attached. Returns the id of the new message and the updated ticket. (permission: support:write) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]
name: gpucloud_reply_ticket
title: Reply to a support ticket
